name: axHub storage (settings and app data on axHub instead of this device)
description: Keeps an app's settings and, if you choose, its data on axHub's data server instead of the device every other app uses. Two classes: HubSettings (one settings document, per-key changes, last save wins, can mirror the app's own Settings screen) and HubData (tables of rows; all tables on axHub, or only the ones you pick, the rest stay on the device). The browser's own hub session, If-Match versions, tables over the hub's 64 KB limit split into chunks. The hub down = an error and a state to show, never a silent local copy. Built Oct 23 2026 for the Voice notes plugin.

params.label: axHub address
params.help: https only (http only for localhost while developing).

params.label: Hub project
params.help: The project folder on the hub (/projects/<name>); blank = the app's project name.

parts.label: Settings on axHub
parts.description: The app's settings live in one document on axHub (HubSettings).

params.label: Settings file
params.help: Path inside the hub project, ends in .json.

params.label: Keep the Settings screen's values on axHub
params.help: Every value the app's own Settings screen saves goes to axHub too, and axHub's copy wins when the app starts.

parts.label: App data on axHub
parts.description: The app's tables (sections of storage) on axHub (HubData): all of them, or only the ones picked here; the rest stay on this device.

params.label: Which tables
params.help: all = every table on axHub; some = only the tables listed below.

params.label: Tables on axHub
params.help: Only with 'some': table names, comma separated.

params.label: Data folder
params.help: Folder inside the hub project that holds the tables.
